description: v0.8.0 Phase 6.7 (item F6) -- Measured tok/s and recommended quantisation per Apple Silicon unified-memory tier. Captured per machine (operator-action); rows added as data becomes available. The PyQt installer's macOS post-install flow reads this file to recommend a starting model + quant.

captures.notes: Placeholder row -- requires Apple Silicon hardware access. Operator must run `npm run bench -- --m-series --machine='M3 Pro 18GB'` on a quiescent host.

16.rationale: 16 GB tier: 4-bit quant fits comfortably with overhead for the editor + VSCode.

24.rationale: 24 GB tier: 4-bit medium quant balances throughput and quality (anchor: jola.dev measured ~40 tok/s).

36.rationale: 36 GB tier: 5-bit quant gives a measurable quality bump with headroom for the editor.

64.rationale: 64+ GB tier: 6-bit quant approaches FP16 quality; operator may also run the e8b checkpoint.
